program.title: Referral program
program.tooltip: Reward existing travelers with promo credits when their friends complete paid bookings on Moja Ride.
program.description: Reward referrers with promo credits when their referred friend completes a paid trip. A personal welcome coupon can be minted for the new traveler from any active campaign.
program.initialRewardTooltip: One-time promo credit granted to the referrer after the referred friend boards and completes their first eligible paid trip.
program.initialRewardSub: One-time credit after the friend's first confirmed trip
program.recurringRewardTooltip: Smaller bonus promo credit given to the referrer every time the friend takes subsequent trips, up to the maximum trips cap.
program.recurringRewardSub: Smaller bonus for each repeat trip the friend takes (up to the cap)
program.maxTripsTooltip: The maximum number of repeat trips that will earn recurring credits for the referrer. Prevents infinite credit drain.
program.maxTripsSub: Stop issuing recurring bonuses after this many trips
program.windowTooltip: Only trips completed within this number of days from the initial referral date qualify for the recurring bonus.
program.windowSub: Only count trips within this many days of the original referral
program.delayTooltip: Grace period after the friend's trip departure before the referrer's promo credits unlock for spending, allowing for cancellations or disputes.
program.delaySub: Hours after the referred friend's trip departure before credits unlock
program.welcomeCampaignTooltip: When linked to an active campaign, new travelers who register through a referral link automatically receive a personal welcome discount code.
program.welcomeCampaignSub: When set, new travelers who register via a referral link receive a personal coupon code from this campaign
program.fraudTooltip: These automated security guards protect promo credit balances against abuse, bot attacks, and collusion.
fraudItems: Requires a confirmed, paid trip before reward matures
program.fraudFooter: These controls are permanently enabled and cannot be disabled to protect platform integrity.
